item.text:
**4B.8 — Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**  
**Bottom line:** mostly yes on term limits and constitutional transfer of power, with a meaningful caveat: he still pushed late-cycle institutional reforms that critics said would entrench Morena and weaken neutral constraints.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| + | [25-06-24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/25-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-25 | AMLO said he was finishing his cycle, that he supported no reelection, that he would leave office for Palenque, and that Sheinbaum was fully prepared to govern. | 4B.8, 4B.5 |
| + | [20-06-24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-20 | AMLO said a vote-by-vote recount was the best way to remove suspicion and that citizens should respect what the electoral authority decides. | 4B.8, 4B.1 |
| + | [Tribunal Electoral valida elección presidencial: Segob; presidente celebra ejemplar transición en gobierno federal](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/tribunal-electoral-valida-eleccion-presidencial-segob-presidente-celebra-ejemplar-transicion-en-gobierno-federal/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-08-13 | After the tribunal validated the presidential election, AMLO publicly celebrated an orderly, constitutional transition to Sheinbaum. | 4B.8 |
| - | [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with supermajority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04 | Reuters said AMLO frequently lambasted the INE and pushed an overhaul critics saw as a way to cement Morena’s political hegemony and weaken contestable power. | 4B.8, 4B.2, 4B.5 |
| - | [Mexico’s sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-15 | Reuters reported the judicial overhaul was enacted despite criticism that it weakened judicial independence, which is negative for constitutional restraint and smooth transfer rules. | 4B.8, 4B.4, 4B.5 |
| - | [Mexican senators push through reform to boost military control over security](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexican-senators-push-through-reform-to-boost-military-control-over-security-3632396) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-09-25 | Reuters reported the Senate approved a reform giving the armed forces control of the civilian-led National Guard, which critics said expanded military power over law and order. | 4B.8, 4B.4 |

**Search gap:** I found direct 2024 evidence that AMLO accepted the election result and the handoff to Sheinbaum. I did not find evidence of an actual 2024 term-limit breach or refusal to transfer office; the main negatives are indirect, coming from late-term reforms that critics said would weaken independent constraints rather than from any open succession crisis.
